## Migrations

### 001_init.sql

Source: `examples/room-booking/script/01-foundation/attempt-1/src/db/migrations/001_init.sql`

```sql
CREATE TABLE users (
  id    serial PRIMARY KEY,
  email text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name  text NOT NULL,
  role  text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user' CHECK (role IN ('user', 'admin'))
);

CREATE TABLE rooms (
  id       serial PRIMARY KEY,
  name     text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  capacity int  NOT NULL CHECK (capacity > 0)
);
```

### 002_bookings.sql

Source: `examples/room-booking/script/04-bookings/attempt-1/src/db/migrations/002_bookings.sql`

```sql
CREATE TABLE bookings (
  id         serial PRIMARY KEY,
  room_id    int         NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id    int         NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  start_at   timestamptz NOT NULL,
  end_at     timestamptz NOT NULL,
  status     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed' CHECK (status IN ('confirmed', 'cancelled')),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (end_at > start_at)
);

CREATE INDEX bookings_room_time_idx ON bookings (room_id, start_at, end_at);
```

### 003_no_overlap.sql

Source: `examples/room-booking/script/05-concurrency/attempt-2/src/db/migrations/003_no_overlap.sql`

```sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;

-- The invariant lives in the database: no two confirmed bookings for a room may overlap.
ALTER TABLE bookings
  ADD CONSTRAINT bookings_no_overlap
  EXCLUDE USING gist (room_id WITH =, tstzrange(start_at, end_at) WITH &&)
  WHERE (status = 'confirmed');
```
